guard.rule: assessment rows dropped before any array is returned; no assessment row id survives; no array of the assessment (13,936) or full-source (39,170) length; no label key in the returned dict; *.assess never imported

reference_vectors.U0: dpc.deploy.load_teacher(<HCAL_PRIV>/admitted/rel__s{k}__U, seed=k) + teacher_probs on the permitted reference rows only (one batch of the four roles)
reference_vectors.Ucal: hcal.calib.apply_u(U0, frozen calU__s{k} H-GLOBAL-TEMP record, d); never refitted
reference_vectors.decision: numpy argmax of U0 (first index); argmax(Ucal) == d asserted on every row
reference_vectors.parity: U0 and d bitwise equal to the admitted hcal teacher.npz on every reference row (teacher.npz is indexed to the permitted rows immediately at load; other rows are never kept)

role_hash_convention: hcal.data.sha_arr (sha256 of dtype + shape + bytes) of the sorted int64 row ids / unique int64 group ids; equal_to_hcal_role_manifest compares with results/pcrl_heldout_calibration_v1/ROLE_MANIFEST.json at 1baf5bbdaf59cfa6a664cae07d652a4712bdfdc5

ATTACK_FIT_NEW.ccm_use: new attacker fitting (pilot only): reference vectors and SEX via labels('attack')

CALIBRATION_HELDOUT.ccm_use: Ucal reference vectors for held-out geometry F4 (fallback rate); label-free; no temperature refit

CALIBRATION_TRAIN_MATCHED.ccm_use: label-free position subset of OSF_DEFENSE_FIT (hcal diagnostic subrole); no use planned

HEAD_VALIDATION.ccm_use: rows kept for features only; labels never readable; no reference vectors served

INNER_SELECTION.ccm_use: bounded exploratory pilot only (after the pushed PILOT_LOCK): reference vectors, SEX via labels('attack') and task labels via labels('utility'); scored once

OSF_DEFENSE_FIT.ccm_use: reference vectors (U0, Ucal) for Stage D geometry F1-F3u and engineering; SEX only via labels('defense_fit') in the pilot (privacy-aware assignment fitting)

rows.dropped_note: all OSF_DEVELOPMENT_ASSESSMENT rows; the one AUDIT_FIT row that is a non-representative member of a CALIBRATION_HELDOUT group (in no ccm role)

source.loader: hcal.data.load(verify=True, unseal=False) -> lra.data -> qpc.data -> dpc.data -> osf.data (pinned blobs, input sha256, role manifests verified by the pinned chain); restricted by ccm.data.restrict before anything is returned

stages.A triage: committed aggregates only; no data access
stages.D geometry (F1-F3u, F5): reference(k, OSF_DEFENSE_FIT): Ucal (and U0 for the secondary note); no labels
stages.E verification (role E): the same reference() outputs and TOY_LAWS.json; no labels
stages.F pilot (only after the pushed PILOT_LOC: reference(k, role) for FIT / ATT / INNER (and HELD for fallback); labels('defense_fit', FIT), labels('attack', ATT | INNER), labels('utility', INNER)
stages.never: OSF_DEVELOPMENT_ASSESSMENT rows, labels or predictions; HEAD_VALIDATION labels
